title: 第九章 我的朋友轮得到你教训第十章 来自老父亲的爱之凝视
content_zh:
说说笑笑，时间过得很快。
酒吧内音乐激荡，气氛火热，大家渐渐玩开了。
此时，许杰和白薇三人正玩着真心话大冒险的游戏。
三个人，以手心手背来决定！
游戏已经进行了几轮，互有输赢，说了些有趣但无伤大雅的真心话。
不想说的，就选择大冒险。
最有趣的一次，余浩让白薇去撩妹子。
结果，谁也没想到，白薇竟然成功了！
那个不幸被选中的美女被她撩的面红耳赤，引来大家一阵捧腹大笑。
而这一次，轮到了余浩。
许杰和白薇高兴的哈哈大笑。
然后许杰出了个馊主意，让余浩说出第一次春梦的对象。
这个问题让余浩的脸涨的像猪肝一样红。
王腾笑着摇了摇头，他并没有参与，毕竟他的秘密太多，玩这种游戏很容易玩脱。
许杰白薇两人在一旁使劲起哄催促，让余浩赶紧说。
王腾站起身，去了趟厕所。
晚上吃了星兽肉，有助于新陈代谢，将体内杂质一同排出。
而且酒吧里的烟味，也让他的烟瘾犯了。
前世他不知道从什么时候开始，一天不抽烟就浑身难受，想戒又戒不掉。
没一会儿，他从厕所出来，又去外面买了包劣质烟。

好的还抽不习惯！
王腾嘴里叼着烟，向许杰几人走去。
刚走到近处，却发现他们被几个人围着，许杰，余浩似乎正和那群人争吵。
那群人流里流气，戴着耳环，身上还纹着纹身，一副“老子很不好惹”
的样子。
王腾不禁皱起了眉头。
这时，其中一个人推搡了许杰一下，骂骂咧咧的说道：“玛的，这小丫头把我的衣服弄脏了，你一句对不起，就想了事？”
“你知道这衣服多少钱吗？”
“赔得起吗？”
“几个小屁孩，也学大人来酒吧玩。”
说着旁边几人哈哈大笑起来，脸上露出嘲弄的表情。
余浩几人哪里受过这种气。
他们这些富二代，本就娇生惯养，走到哪里都是别人奉承讨好的对象。
要是身份地位比他们更高的人，受一点委屈也就罢了，可是这几个明显就是不知道从哪个犄角疙瘩里冒出来的小喽啰。
若是当真被这样的人欺负了，传出去怕是都会成为其他富二代圈子里的笑话。
许杰被人推了一下，脸色更是沉了下来。
不过别看他平时一副大大咧咧，老天第一我第二的样子，实际上并非什么无脑之人。
这时候，对方明显人多，而他们之中还有女生在。
起了冲突，吃亏的肯定是他们。
再说如今可是武道时代，有些人看起来其貌不扬的，万一是个高手怎么办？

那不得死翘翘！
content_en:
Talking and laughing, time flies by.
The music in the bar was surging, the atmosphere was fiery, and everyone was gradually having fun.
At this time, Xu Jie and Bai Wei were playing a game of truth or dare.
Three people, decide based on the palm of your hand!
The game has gone on for several rounds, with winners and losers, and some interesting but harmless truths said.
If you don’t want to say anything, choose a big adventure.
The most interesting time was when Yu Hao asked Bai Wei to flirt with a girl.
In the end, no one expected that Bai Wei succeeded!
The beautiful woman who was unlucky to be chosen turned red in the face due to her teasing, which made everyone burst into laughter.
But this time, it was Yu Hao's turn.
Xu Jie and Bai Wei laughed happily.
Then Xu Jie came up with a bad idea and asked Yu Hao to reveal the object of his first sexual dream.
This question made Yu Hao's face turn as red as pig liver.
Wang Teng smiled and shook his head. He was not involved. After all, he had too many secrets and it was easy to get out of this game.
Xu Jie and Bai Wei were urging Yu Hao to speak quickly.
Wang Teng stood up and went to the toilet.
Eating star beast meat at night helps metabolism and eliminates impurities from the body.
And the smell of cigarettes in the bar also made him addicted to cigarettes.
In his previous life, he didn't know when he started feeling uncomfortable if he didn't smoke for a day, and he wanted to quit but couldn't.
After a while, he came out of the toilet and went outside to buy a pack of low-quality cigarettes.
It’s so good but I’m not used to it!
Wang Teng walked towards Xu Jie and others with a cigarette in his mouth.
As soon as they got closer, they found that they were surrounded by several people. Xu Jie and Yu Hao seemed to be arguing with the group of people.
The group of people were arrogant, wearing earrings and tattoos, and looked like "I'm not easy to mess with."
look like.
Wang Teng couldn't help but frowned.
At this time, one of them pushed Xu Jie and said cursingly: "Damn, this little girl soiled my clothes. You just said sorry and thought nothing of it?"
"Do you know how much these clothes cost?"
"Can you afford the compensation?"
"A few little brats are imitating adults and coming to the bar to play."
As he spoke, several people next to him burst out laughing, with mocking expressions on their faces.
How could Yu Hao and the others have ever been so angry?
They, the rich second generation, are spoiled and pampered, and they are the objects of flattery and flattery wherever they go.
It would be fine if people with a higher status than them would feel a little wronged, but these few were obviously little minions who emerged from nowhere.
If you are really bullied by such a person, if word spreads about it, it will probably become a joke among other rich second-generation circles.
Xu Jie was pushed and his face darkened.
But despite his usual careless, God-first and me-second attitude, he is actually not a brainless person.
At this time, there were obviously many people on the other side, and there were girls among them.
If there is a conflict, they will definitely suffer.
Besides, this is the era of martial arts, and some people look ugly. What if they are a master?
Then you must die!
